acceptanceCriteria: GPK-V0-020 states the licence of new production Go paths as the AGPL-3.0-or-later product layer that LICENSING.md defines, and leaves the plain Apache-2.0 boundary paths unchanged.
The amendment is owner-approved because GPK-V0-020 is an accepted requirement; REQUIREMENTS.tsv is regenerated and the doc checks pass.
body: GPK-V0-020 in docs/specs/go-production-kernel-migration-v0.md:704-708 says new production Go paths "remain Apache-2.0 subject to Commons Clause v1.0". LICENSING.md and decision 0002 put every product path, including cmd/** and internal/**, under AGPL-3.0-or-later (public snapshot, decision 0331), with plain Apache-2.0 only for the enumerated protocol/spec/conformance/interop paths and the three owner-approved frontier files (decision 0422 A5, V1-0379). The spec text therefore contradicts the licence a recipient actually receives. It is the only occurrence of Commons Clause in the tracked Markdown. GPK-V0-020 is an accepted requirement, so the corrected wording needs owner approval. Found while preparing beamfall/corvint#269; not changed there.
title: Correct the GPK-V0-020 licence wording that still names Apache-2.0 with Commons Clause
